# Minimal CyTOF run

The CyTOF entry point uses the `exprs` (arcsinh-transformed) assay of a
`SingleCellExperiment`. `unpack_sce_cytof()` extracts the matrix and the
`colData` data frame in the shape `run_scProteinXpress()` expects.

```{r}
library(scProtXpress)

sce <- readRDS("data/cytof_reference.rds")
unpacked <- unpack_sce_cytof(sce, assay_name = "exprs",
                             batch_default_col = "dataset_id")

run_scProteinXpress(
  data            = unpacked$data,
  metadata        = unpacked$metadata,
  dir             = "results",
  file.name       = "CyTOF_run",
  modality        = "CyTOF",
  cell_id_col     = "cell_id",
  cell_type_col   = "cell_type",
  dataset_col     = "dataset_id",
  sample_col      = "sample_id",
  batch_col       = "batch",
  tissue_default  = "PBMC",
  num.boot.sample = 1000L,
  ncores          = 4L,
  is_transformed  = unpacked$is_transformed
)
```

# External query against a cached reference

```{r}
sce_q   <- readRDS("data/cytof_query.rds")
unpacked_q <- unpack_sce_cytof(sce_q)

run_scProteinXpress(
  data           = unpacked_q$data,
  metadata       = unpacked_q$metadata,
  dir            = "results/Query_disease",
  file.name      = "disease",
  precBack       = "results/Ref_CyTOF_run",
  modality       = "CyTOF",
  ncores         = 4L,
  is_transformed = unpacked_q$is_transformed
)
```

# Activate SQS (opt-in)

By default `apply_sqs = "none"` and no SQS scores are logged. To turn it
on for the reference build only:

```{r}
run_scProteinXpress(
  data            = unpacked$data,
  metadata        = unpacked$metadata,
  dir             = "results",
  file.name       = "CyTOF_run_with_sqs",
  modality        = "CyTOF",
  apply_sqs       = "ref_only",
  sqs_threshold   = 1.0,
  num.boot.sample = 1000L,
  ncores          = 4L,
  is_transformed  = TRUE
)
```

The per-marker / per-sample scores are written to
`<Ref_dir>/<file.name>_SQS_ref_log.csv`. To generate the diagnostic
PNG, `source()` the optional reporter:

```{r}
source(system.file("sqs/sqs_report.R", package = "scProtXpress"))
df <- load_sqs_logs(ref_dir = "results/Ref_CyTOF_run_with_sqs")
save_sqs_report(df, out_dir = "results/SQS_report")
```

# Cell-level outlier filter

`qc_outlier_cells = "auto"` (default) leaves the scuttle filter OFF for
CyTOF. To force it on, pass `"yes"`:

```{r}
run_scProteinXpress(
  data             = unpacked$data,
  metadata         = unpacked$metadata,
  dir              = "results",
  file.name        = "CyTOF_filtered",
  modality         = "CyTOF",
  qc_outlier_cells = "yes",
  qc_nmads         = 3,
  num.boot.sample  = 1000L,
  ncores           = 4L,
  is_transformed   = TRUE
)
```
